propositions: The budget enforcement machinery in ledger.py is bound to a single $200 epic ceiling via module globals, preventing a second epic from enforcing its own independent ceiling.
Multiple epics sharing one ledger file and one cap can mutually interfere: one epic may be refused for another's spending, or both may clear pre-flight separately yet jointly exceed the cap.
The estimate() function only recognizes tier1 and tier2 tiers and raises ValueError for unknown tiers, preventing pre-flighting of parent epic's per-criterion eval work.

Adding keyword-only cap_usd and reserve_usd parameters to reserve() and print_summary() with defaults matching current globals enables parameterized ceilings while preserving backward compatibility of all existing call sites.
New estimate keys 'criteria-eval-cheap' (0.03) and 'criteria-eval-agent' (0.25) derived from production ledger data must be added to PER_SAMPLE_ESTIMATE_USD to support parent epic pricing.
